extName.description: Extension name (shown in the browser and Web Store).

extDesc.message: Select files or folders on a GitHub repository tree and download them as a ZIP archive.

toastManyFiles.message: Selected {1} files — packaging may take a while…

toastDoneSkippedFailed.message: Done: {1} file(s), skipped {2} special item(s), {3} failed

errAllFailed.message: All downloads failed. Check your network or API rate limit.

errZipLimit.message: Too many files for one ZIP (over 65535). Download in batches.

errTokenInvalid.message: Invalid token. Check it in the extension settings.

errRepoNotFound.message: Repository not found, or it is private — configure a token in settings.

errRateLimit.message: GitHub API rate limit reached. Retry later or configure a token in settings.

errFetchTree.message: Failed to fetch the file list (HTTP {1}).

errRepoTooLarge.message: This repository has too many files (over 100,000) — not supported.

popupDesc.message: Click Download on a GitHub code page, select files or folders, then download them as a ZIP.

optSub.message: Configure a GitHub Personal Access Token to raise the API rate limit from 60/hour (anonymous) to 5000/hour (authenticated) and to download private repositories.

optHint.message: For read-only public downloads, a fine-grained token with Public Repositories (read-only) is enough; private repositories need Contents: Read.

optUsage1.message: Open any GitHub repository code page (github.com/owner/repo).

optUsage2.message: Click the Download button in the header toolbar to enter selection mode.

optUsage3.message: Select the files/folders you want, then click Download.

optUsage4.message: The selection is packed into a ZIP and downloaded.

optNote.message: Submodules, symlinks and Git LFS files are skipped automatically.
